questions.subject: COMPUTING_PRINCIPLES
questions.learningObjective: Analyze how IP address applies in a computing setting.

stimulus.body: The Internet: a case involving 1100 packets. Consider how IP address governs the situation.

questions.stem: Which statement about IP address holds for 1100 packets?

options.text: A numeric address for a device

options.misconception: Confuses IP address with domain name

options.text: A port number for an application

questions.explanation: IP address: An IP address is a numeric label that identifies a device on a network so packets can be delivered to it. With 1100 packets in view, that principle distinguishes the correct choice; every other option rests on a specific misconception.
questions.hint: Which address do routers use to forward packets?
